verses.original: עָלָ֥ה מֵפִ֛יץ עַל־ פָּנַ֖יִךְ נָצ֣וֹר מְצֻרָ֑ה צַפֵּה־ דֶ֙רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מָתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ כֹּ֖חַ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāh mê·p̄îṣ ‘al- pā·na·yiḵ nā·ṣō·wr mə·ṣu·rāh ṣap·pêh- ḏe·reḵ ḥaz·zêq mā·ṯə·na·yim ’am·mêṣ kō·aḥ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh Guard the fortress Watch the road Brace yourselves . . . Summon all your strength

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּגְא֖וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י בְקָקוּם֙ בֹּֽקְקִ֔ים וּזְמֹרֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁחֵֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî šāḇ Yah·weh ’eṯ- gə·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ kiḡ·’ō·wn yiś·rā·’êl kî ḇə·qā·qūm bō·qə·qîm ū·zə·mō·rê·hem ši·ḥê·ṯū
verses.literal: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine

verses.original: מָגֵ֨ן גִּבֹּרֵ֜יהוּ מְאָדָּ֗ם אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֙יִל֙ מְתֻלָּעִ֔ים בְּאֵשׁ־ פְּלָד֥וֹת הָרֶ֖כֶב בְּי֣וֹם הֲכִינ֑וֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁ֖ים הָרְעָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḡên gib·bō·rê·hū mə·’ād·dām ’an·šê- ḥa·yil mə·ṯul·lā·‘îm bə·’êš- pə·lā·ḏō·wṯ hā·re·ḵeḇ bə·yō·wm hă·ḵî·nōw wə·hab·bə·rō·šîm hā·rə·‘ā·lū
verses.literal: The shields of his mighty men are red the valiant warriors . . . are dressed in scarlet The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared and the spears of cypress have been brandished

verses.original: בַּֽחוּצוֹת֙ יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּן בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן֙ כַּלַּפִּידִ֔ם כַּבְּרָקִ֖ים יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ yiṯ·hō·wl·lū hā·re·ḵeḇ yiš·taq·šə·qūn bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ mar·’ê·hen kal·lap·pî·ḏim kab·bə·rā·qîm yə·rō·w·ṣê·ṣū
verses.literal: The chariots dash through the streets they rush around the plazas appearing like torches darting about like lightning

verses.original: יִזְכֹּר֙ אַדִּירָ֔יו יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ בַהֲלִכוֹתָם יְמַֽהֲרוּ֙ חֽוֹמָתָ֔הּ וְהֻכַ֖ן הַסֹּכֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·kōr ’ad·dî·rāw yik·kā·šə·lū ḇa·hă·li·ḵō·ṯå̄m yə·ma·hă·rū ḥō·w·mā·ṯāh wə·hu·ḵan has·sō·ḵêḵ
verses.literal: He summons his nobles they stumble as they advance They race to its wall the protective shield is set in place
The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses

verses.original: וְהֻצַּ֖ב גֻּלְּתָ֣ה הֹֽעֲלָ֑תָה וְאַמְהֹתֶ֗יהָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת֙ כְּק֣וֹל יוֹנִ֔ים מְתֹפְפֹ֖ת עַל־ לִבְבֵהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·huṣ·ṣaḇ gul·lə·ṯāh hō·‘ă·lā·ṯāh wə·’am·hō·ṯe·hā mə·na·hă·ḡō·wṯ kə·qō·wl yō·w·nîm mə·ṯō·p̄ə·p̄ōṯ ‘al- liḇ·ḇê·hen
verses.literal: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away her maidservants moan like doves and beat upon their breasts

verses.original: וְנִינְוֵ֥ה כִבְרֵֽכַת־ מַ֖יִם מִ֣ימֵי הִ֑יא וְהֵ֣מָּה נָסִ֔ים עִמְד֥וּ עֲמֹ֖דוּ וְאֵ֥ין מַפְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nî·nə·wêh ḵiḇ·rê·ḵaṯ- ma·yim mî·mê hî wə·hêm·māh nā·sîm ‘im·ḏū ‘ă·mō·ḏū wə·’ên map̄·neh
verses.literal: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days but now it is draining away Stop Stop!” they cry but no one turns back

verses.original: בֹּ֥זּוּ כֶ֖סֶף בֹּ֣זּוּ זָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֙צֶה֙ לַתְּכוּנָ֔ה כָּבֹ֕ד מִכֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bōz·zū ḵe·sep̄ bōz·zū zā·hāḇ wə·’ên qê·ṣeh lat·tə·ḵū·nāh kā·ḇōḏ mik·kōl kə·lî ḥem·dāh
verses.literal: Plunder the silver Plunder the gold There is no end to the treasure an abundance of every precious thing

verses.original: בּוּקָ֥ה וּמְבוּקָ֖ה וּמְבֻלָּקָ֑ה וְלֵ֨ב נָמֵ֜ס וּפִ֣ק בִּרְכַּ֗יִם וְחַלְחָלָה֙ בְּכָל־ מָתְנַ֔יִם וּפְנֵ֥י כֻלָּ֖ם קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: bū·qāh ū·mə·ḇū·qāh ū·mə·ḇul·lā·qāh wə·lêḇ nā·mês ū·p̄iq bir·ka·yim wə·ḥal·ḥā·lāh bə·ḵāl mā·ṯə·na·yim ū·p̄ə·nê ḵul·lām qib·bə·ṣū p̄ā·rūr
verses.literal: She is emptied Yes , she is desolate and laid waste Hearts melt knees knock bodies tremble and every face . . . grows pale . . .

verses.original: אַיֵּה֙ מְע֣וֹן אֲרָי֔וֹת וּמִרְעֶ֥ה ה֖וּא לַכְּפִרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַךְ֩ אַרְיֵ֨ה לָבִ֥יא שָׁ֛ם גּ֥וּר אַרְיֵ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yêh mə·‘ō·wn ’ă·rā·yō·wṯ ū·mir·‘eh hū lak·kə·p̄i·rîm ’ă·šer hā·laḵ ’ar·yêh lā·ḇî šām gūr ’ar·yêh wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground . . . of the young lions where the lion and lioness . . . prowled with their cubs with nothing to frighten them away

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֤ה טֹרֵף֙ בְּדֵ֣י גֹֽרוֹתָ֔יו וּמְחַנֵּ֖ק לְלִבְאֹתָ֑יו וַיְמַלֵּא־ טֶ֣רֶף חֹרָ֔יו וּמְעֹֽנֹתָ֖יו טְרֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·yêh ṭō·rêp̄ bə·ḏê ḡō·rō·w·ṯāw ū·mə·ḥan·nêq lə·liḇ·’ō·ṯāw way·mal·lê- ṭe·rep̄ ḥō·rāw ū·mə·‘ō·nō·ṯāw ṭə·rê·p̄āh
verses.literal: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness It filled its dens with the kill and its lairs with mauled prey

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְהִבְעַרְתִּ֤י בֶֽעָשָׁן֙ רִכְבָּ֔הּ וּכְפִירַ֖יִךְ תֹּ֣אכַל חָ֑רֶב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ טַרְפֵּ֔ךְ וְלֹֽא־ יִשָּׁמַ֥ע ע֖וֹד ק֥וֹל מַלְאָכֵֽכֵה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ’ê·la·yiḵ nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·hiḇ·‘ar·tî ḇe·‘ā·šān riḵ·bāh ū·ḵə·p̄î·ra·yiḵ tō·ḵal ḥā·reḇ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mê·’e·reṣ ṭar·pêḵ wə·lō- yiš·šā·ma‘ ‘ō·wḏ qō·wl mal·’ā·ḵê·ḵêh
verses.literal: Behold I am against you declares the LORD of Hosts I will reduce your chariots to cinders and the sword will devour your young lions I will cut off your prey from the earth and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard
